How to convert voxel to mesh with MeshInspector
How to convert voxel to mesh with MeshInspector When one deals with CT scan data, the underlying model is represented as voxel data. A voxel, i.e., volumetric pixel, is effectively a cube in a 3D grid. Each of them holds a density or intensity value.
